item.title: Changes in human biomarkers of exposure after complete switching from cigarettes to e-cigarettes or exclusive e-cigarette use: a systematic review and biomarker-specific meta-analysis
item.description: A new systematic review and meta-analysis published inArchives of Toxicology, covering 60 studies, found substantial reductions in exposure to harmful chemicals among smokers who switched completely to e-cigarettes. (Published on October 26, 2026byspringer.com)
